item.title: Getting started with GitHub
item.description:
Introduction

In this guide, we will explore GitHub, covering:

  • What is GitHub?
  • Why use GitHub?
  • How to use GitHub?

What is GitHub?

Before diving into GitHub, it is essential to understand Git and Open-Source Projects.

1. Git

Git is a distributed version control system that allows developers to track changes in their projects, revert to previous versions, and collaborate efficiently.

2. Open-Source Projects

Open-source projects are software projects where the source code is publicly available, allowing anyone to use, modify, and contribute to the development.

item.title: Hugo: The Fastest Static Site Generator
item.description:
What is Hugo?

Hugo is an open-source static site generator (SSG) written in Go. It is designed for speed, simplicity, and flexibility, making it a popular choice for building blogs, documentation sites, and personal portfolios. Unlike traditional content management systems (CMS) like WordPress, Hugo generates static HTML files that can be served directly from any web server, eliminating the need for a database.
